rules.statement: A deed of transfer for valuable consideration cannot be interpreted as a deed of gift due to a statement made by the Notary Public in his attestation.
rules.supporting_quote: If the same wisdom is applied here to the case at hand, owing to the reasons mentioned before, the argument that the deed is a deed of gift owing to the aforesaid statement of the Notary which is not even a condition or term in the main part of the deed must fail.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance, No. 59 of 1939
